groups.activity: side with the Grineer when a Karak Wraith part is the reward
groups.meta: 3 missions for the same side pays the reward

rows.label: Karak Wraith Blueprint
rows.note: 1.11% per Grineer-side invasion; MR 7 to acquire by trade

conditions: Check which side lists the Karak part before you start: siding with the Corpus pays a Dera Vandal part instead (2.76% each).
Finish the third mission before the invasion ends, or you get no battle pay. Switching sides mid-invasion resets your progress.
Parts rotate quickly and some invasions end within hours, so look at the Invasions tab once a day.
bonuses: The reward goes to your inbox even if the other faction wins the node; missions past 3 add nothing.
Strun Wraith, Latron Wraith, Twin Vipers Wraith and Sheev parts come from the same Grineer side.
Battle pay also drops Fieldron, Detonite Injectors, Mutagen Mass, Orokin Catalysts, Reactors, Forma and Exilus Adapter blueprints.

disclosures.title: the wait
disclosures.body: Players estimate about two weeks for a full invasion weapon with a daily check, but one waited roughly four months for the last piece of another. Weapon invasions arrive in clusters after dry spells. Don't pay platinum for the parts; they are not rare.

disclosures.title: invasion hazards
disclosures.body: After a Grineer invasion the Zanuka Hunter ambushes you in later missions, and The Grustrag Three if you sided Corpus. An Exterminate whose last enemies spawn slowly can stall the exit; wait out a bad mission type, as they rotate every 15 minutes.
